name: City of Vicenza and the Palladian Villas of the Veneto
description: In northern Italy's Veneto region, Vicenza is a compact city shaped by the 16th-century architect Andrea Palladio, who drew on ancient Roman buildings for his designs. Visitors can see his Basilica Palladiana, the Teatro Olimpico and grand town palaces, then explore country villas nearby. In all, 47 Palladian buildings are listed, and their style went on to influence architecture across Europe and North America.
